subject: Emotions
title: Arranged vs Chosen Love
description: A quick win: understand Arranged vs Chosen Love.

hook.text: In India, divorce in arranged marriages is 1-2%. In the U.S., chosen marriages hit 40-50%. Does love need choice?

buildup.text: Arranged marriages start with commitment and build love. Chosen marriages start with love and hope commitment follows.

discovery.text: Gupta and Singh found that love in arranged marriages grows over time, while love in chosen marriages often declines.

twist.text: Low divorce rates don't mean more joy—social pressure, economics, and stigma keep unhappy arranged marriages intact too.

climax.text: The real insight: love can start from choice or from arrangement. The path differs but the destination can be identical.

punchline.text: Arranged marriages prove love doesn't need a spark. It needs a commitment.

quiz.question: What trend did Gupta and Singh find in arranged vs chosen marriages?
options: Arranged love grows; chosen love often declines
